blind.description: A stylized fantasy/arcane wooden bookcase with decorative molded cornices and four short feet. The five interior shelves are densely packed with colorful books (red, green, tan, brown), rolled scrolls, a chalice, and small potions. On top of the bookcase rests a reddish-brown leather-bound tome lying flat alongside a stack of three rolled parchment scrolls bound with leather straps. The mesh surfaces are solid, continuous, and cleanly textured in a hand-painted fantasy RPG style with no broken geometry or floating parts.
blind.from_above: A rectangular brown wooden top surface with slightly flared front and side lips, bearing a stack of cream-colored parchment rolls bound with brown straps beside a reddish-brown rectangular book lying flat.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 5 ft 2 in tall including the items on top (just shorter than the 5 ft 9 in figure), roughly 2.5 ft wide and 1.2 ft deep.
